name: Slatten Ranch Shopping Center
summary: Slatten Ranch Shopping Center is a community-oriented retail destination in Antioch offering a convenient mix of shops, restaurants, and services with ample parking. With over 2,200 positive reviews, it serves as a popular neighborhood gathering spot for everyday shopping and dining needs.
demographics: Slatten Ranch Shopping Center serves the growing suburban community of Antioch, California, attracting primarily middle-income families and young professionals from the East Bay area. The trade area consists of households with moderate to middle income levels, with a mix of families with children, working adults, and retirees seeking convenient neighborhood shopping. Visitors typically engage in routine shopping trips for groceries, dining, and everyday services, with strong weekday evening and weekend traffic patterns reflecting the area's commuter-oriented lifestyle.
description: Slatten Ranch Shopping Center is a well-established community shopping destination located at 5749 Lone Tree Way in Antioch, California. This open-air retail center serves as a convenient hub for East Bay residents, offering a practical mix of shops and eateries that cater to everyday needs. The center features popular retailers including GameStop, along with a variety of dining options that make it an ideal spot for both quick errands and leisurely visits. With ample parking and a thoughtfully designed layout, Slatten Ranch provides an accessible and comfortable shopping experience for the local community. The center has earned a solid reputation among visitors, boasting a 4.3-star rating from over 2,200 reviews, with shoppers particularly appreciating its reasonable selection of stores, convenient location, and welcoming atmosphere that makes it a great place for both shopping and people-watching.
